productLossClosed: The current Web and Lynx-for-Web command palettes have identical 576x326 panel geometry, 574x48 search geometry, 574x236 results geometry, 574x40 footer geometry, and 558x32 action rows.
Both Browser renderers expose the same six root action labels and shared footer anatomy.
Real Browser pointer hover paints the Add project row in both renderers.
Web CDP keyboard input proves ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, Backspace, and Escape transitions.
Exact Native dark and light render the same seven-row fixture anatomy and dismiss through a measured outside tap.
runtimeBlockers: Lynxtron 0.0.8 DevTool converts Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent mouseMoved into touch semantics and does not trigger the Native main-thread mouse-enter handler. A diagnostic run was rejected rather than counted as a product failure.
Lynxtron 0.0.8 does not implement Input.dispatchKeyEvent for the LynxView, so Native physical Arrow, Enter, Backspace, Escape, and Cmd+K acceptance remains pending-user-session under R5.
Native physical hover remains pending-user-session under R6; Browser pointer hover cannot substitute for it.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Native palette height is 397.97px for the seven-row fixture while the paired Browser command-navigation state has six root rows and a 326px panel. Geometry is only compared within equivalent fixtures.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Browser evidence uses one shared isolated server and real CDP pointer/keyboard events. Native evidence uses exact production-bundle geometry and a real DevTool outside tap. No DevTool mouse-move or synthetic handler result is credited as Native physical hover or keyboard evidence.

rejectedDiagnostic.reason: DevTool mouseMoved left data-palette-active on the initial row because the desktop bridge maps the event to touch; this cannot determine whether a physical mouse drives main-thread mouseenter.
